name: – Billy Kelleher – After § 6 – Am 6
title: REPORT on gender inequalities in health, specifically as regards gender-specific conditions
part_text: 6a. Stresses that women’s health must be recognised as a priority in health policy, medical research and clinical practice; emphasises the need to improve knowledge and understanding of women’s biological and physiological specificities, including sex-specific symptoms, hormonal factors and the different stages of women’s lives; calls for these specificities to be systematically taken into account in medical education and training, prevention, research, diagnosis, clinical guidelines and treatment, in order to ensure safe, effective and appropriately tailored healthcare for women;
